name: python-kwargs-setattr-security
description: When reviewing or fixing Python code that uses setattr() with user-controlled kwargs to configure C++ extension objects (SessionOptions, RunOptions, etc.) in ONNX Runtime. Use this to apply the allowlist pattern that prevents arbitrary file writes and other attacks via reflected property access.
readme_snippet: Problem Pattern Using hasattr(obj, k) / setattr(obj, k, v) with user-controlled kwargs is insecure. The hasattr check is NOT a security guard — it returns True for ALL exposed properties including dangerous ones. Fix: Explicit Allowlist Define a module-level frozenset of safe attribute names. Raise RuntimeError for known-but-blocked attrs; silently ignore unknown keys. Key Rules Use the existing object in hasattr(options, k) — never hasattr(ClassName(), k) (creates throwaway C++ objects per iteration) RuntimeError is the ORT convention for API misuse errors (not ValueError) Silent ignore for one path is OK when kwargs are forwarded to both paths: runmodel() passes the same kwargs dict to both prepare() (validates SessionOptions) and rep.run() (validates RunOptions). A RunOptions kwarg unknown to SessionOptions is silently ignored by prepare() — this is correct because rep.run() will validate it. Only raise RuntimeError when the attr exists on the target object but is blocked.

readme_snippet: Storage layout detection When this applies UUPS / Transparent proxy upgrades OpenZeppelin Upgradeable contracts EIP-2535 Diamonds with shared storage Libraries that read storage via assembly Any change that modifies inheritance order or struct layout in an upgradeable contract Initializers that depend on storage being zero Detection patterns Missing gap (HIGH) OZ convention: each base contract reserves gap for future fields. Slot collision between proxy and implementation (CRITICAL) Implementation defines address public owner in slot 0; proxy uses slot 0 for its admin. Hello, hijacked proxy. Use EIP-1967 slots (bytes32(uint256(keccak256("eip1967.proxy.implementation")) - 1)). Inheritance reorder breaks layout (HIGH) Even one append to a parent breaks all descendants. Struct field reorder/insert (HIGH) Solidity packs adjacent same-bit-width fields. Inserting a bool between two uint256 adds a slot. Verify with forge inspect storage. Type widening (HIGH) uint8 → uint256 changes packing.

readme_snippet: Vercel CLI Design System This skill defines the Vercel CLI we are building toward. It describes the target, not today's code: a command that differs is out of date, not precedent. Changes move the CLI toward it within the scope of the change. Breaking changes are allowed through Changing a contract. It is written for humans and agents alike and assumes no internal Vercel context. MUST / NEVER are requirements. SHOULD is the default; deviate only with a stated reason in the PR. MAY is optional. The Bar Every command answers four questions, for a person at a terminal and for a script: What will it act on? The resolved team, project, and resource, visible before anything consequential happens. What will change? Risky or broad effects are shown before they happen. Nothing is a surprise. What happened? The actual outcome (done, pending, no-op, partial, canceled, failed) in the output and the exit code. What next? One exact, working command when there is a useful next step.

name: grilling
description: 围绕计划、decision 或 idea 持续追问用户。适用于用户想对自己的思路做压力测试，或使用任何 “grill” 触发措辞时。
readme_snippet: 持续访谈用户，直到达成共同理解。把这件事映射成一棵 design tree：每个 decision 都分支到挂在它下面的那些 decisions。 按 rounds 逐轮处理这棵树。frontier 是那些 prerequisites 已经敲定的 decisions，也就是你现在就可以问、无需猜测还没听到的答案的那些问题。在一轮里问完整条 frontier：给每个问题编号并附上你的推荐答案。然后等用户回答，再进入下一轮。 每一轮的格式如下: 每个问题的措辞都要让回答 “yes” 就是接受你的推荐答案。 每一轮用户给出的回答都会重塑这棵树：敲定的 decisions 会把 frontier 向外推，并解锁依赖它们的问题。重新计算 frontier，然后问下一轮。其答案依赖本轮中另一个仍未解决的问题，属于 更晚的 一轮，而不是本轮。 寻找 facts 是你的工作，绝不是用户的。当一个 frontier 问题需要来自 environment（filesystem、tools 等）的 fact 时，派一个 sub-agent 去查，不要问用户任何你自己能查到的东西。不要被它阻塞：一次正在进行的探索是一个尚未敲定的 prerequisite，所以只有它下游的问题才需要等 sub-agent 回报，现在先问 frontier 的其余部分。decisions 属于用户：逐个交给他，并等待。 当 frontier 为空时，会话才算结束：design tree 的每个分支都访问过，没有留下任何被默默假设的东西。在用户确认我们已经达成共同理解之前，不要采取行动。
